Attentes et critères élevés de résultat ou de comportement qu’entretient ordinairement une personne envers elle-même, ainsi qu’envers d’autres personnes, notamment en contexte professionnel ou artistique.

examples.text: Travailler avec Camille [Chaplain] m’a montré que le talent et l’exigence peuvent coexister sans paradoxe avec le respect et la douceur. Elle restera pour moi une mentor, un modèle.

examples.text: Une telle articulation conduit à moraliser le royaume futur et à téléologiser les exigences de la morale.

glosses: berechtigte Forderung an etwas oder jemanden: Forderung, Erwartung

examples.text: Als Chef stellte er allerhöchste Ansprüche an sich selbst und an seine Mitarbeiter.
Er konnte dem an ihn gestellten Anspruch zu keiner Zeit gerecht werden.
Mein Beruf nimmt mich zur Zeit vollkommen in Anspruch.

glosses: The desire to purchase goods and services.

examples.text: Prices usually go up when demand exceeds supply.

glosses: The amount of a good or service that consumers are willing to buy at a particular price.
A forceful claim for something.

examples.text: Modern society is responding to women's demands for equality.

The humor of my proposition appealed more strongly to Miss Trevor than I had looked for, and from that time forward she became her old self again;[…]. Our table in the dining-room became again the abode of scintillating wit and caustic repartee, Farrar bracing up to his old standard, and the demand for seats in the vicinity rose to an animated competition.

glosses: A requirement.

examples.text: His job makes many demands on his time.

glosses: An urgent request.

examples.text: She couldn't ignore the newborn baby's demands for attention.

glosses: An order.

glosses: To claim a right to something.

examples.text: The bank is demanding the mortgage payment.

glosses: To ask forcefully for information.

examples.text: I demand an immediate explanation.

⁠And home to Mary’s house return’d,

glosses: To require of someone.

examples.text: This job demands a lot of patience.

glosses: To issue a summons to court.

A necessity or prerequisite; something required or obligatory. Its adpositions are generally of in relation to who or what has given it, on in relation to whom or what it is given to, and for in relation to what is required.

examples.text: Near-synonyms: necessity, prerequisite, requisite, condition, rule
The requirements of life as we know it include carbon, oxygen, hydrogen, water, and energy.

glosses: Something asked.

examples.text: Near-synonym: request

glosses: A statement (in domain specific terms) which specifies a verifiable constraint on an implementation that it shall undeniably meet or (a) be deemed unacceptable, or (b) result in implementation failure, or (c) result in system failure.

examples.text: Near-synonyms: specification, rule
System requirements not met. Go to Settings to learn more.

glosses: The demands or requirements of a situation.

examples.text: My business is with you, and you only. You should not have undertaken your office, unless prepared for its various exigencies.

[...] but these details I am compelled by exigencies of space to hold over until next month.

glosses: An urgent situation, one requiring extreme effort or attention.
